# Humanizer Pro

> An agent skill and a local command-line checker that find the habits that make text read as machine-written, remove them, and check that every fact survived the edit. It runs offline with no account or API key.

Install it as a Claude Code plugin, with `npx skills add eddyplolz/humanizer-pro` for other agents, or with `pip install humanizer-pro` for the `humanizer-audit` checker.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/eddyplolz/humanizer-pro/blob/main/README.md): what it does, how to install it, and how to run the checker
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/eddyplolz/humanizer-pro/blob/main/SKILL.md): the skill an agent loads, with its modes and workflow
- [Checker usage](https://github.com/eddyplolz/humanizer-pro/blob/main/scripts/README.md): `humanizer-audit` options, output and exit codes

## Reference

- [Tell catalog](https://github.com/eddyplolz/humanizer-pro/blob/main/reference/tell-catalog.md): every writing habit the skill looks for, with examples
- [Chatbot artifacts](https://github.com/eddyplolz/humanizer-pro/blob/main/reference/llm-artifacts.md): citation markers, placeholders and other text a chatbot leaves behind
- [Worked examples](https://github.com/eddyplolz/humanizer-pro/blob/main/reference/worked-examples.md): before and after rewrites
- [Registers](https://github.com/eddyplolz/humanizer-pro/blob/main/reference/registers.md): how the rules change for different kinds of writing
- [Wiki mode](https://github.com/eddyplolz/humanizer-pro/blob/main/reference/wiki-mode.md): neutral, sourced encyclopedia writing
- [AI check](https://github.com/eddyplolz/humanizer-pro/blob/main/reference/ai-check.md): the audit-only mode that scores text without rewriting it

- [Changelog](https://github.com/eddyplolz/humanizer-pro/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): every release and what changed

- [GitHub Action](https://github.com/eddyplolz/humanizer-pro/blob/main/action.yml): run the checker in CI
